method: Independent numerical and analytic model checks, not renderer assertions.

checks.claim: Normalized sinc-squared intensity vanishes at the first positive and negative minima.
Halving width from six to three wavelengths doubles the sine of the first dark angle.
The angular width itself is not claimed to double exactly.

limitations: Far-field, uniform coherent illumination of one slit. Horizontal pattern coordinate is sine angle. Peak normalization and compressed display brightness do not conserve or compare transmitted power.
